bull.b: FTC Solar’s mix of tracker hardware plus engineering, software and field services creates recurring service and aftermarket opportunity, strengthening customer lock-in and bankability. Continued cash burn over several quarters raises refinancing and dilution risk, constrains investment in manufacturing efficiency, and limits flexibility to fund backlog without new capital.

Negative shareholders' equity reflects accumulated losses and reduces financial resilience. A strained capital structure limits borrowing capacity and supplier credit, complicates project financing and bankability discussions with developers and EPCs, and raises the probability of equity raises or covenant pressure.

bear.t: Deeply negative margins and revenue weakness
bear.b: Very low gross margins and large operating losses indicate structural cost or pricing issues and exposure to commodity and manufacturing inefficiencies. Even with revenue improvement, entrenched negative margins make achieving sustainable profitability and positive cash flow challenging without operational restructuring or pricing power gains.
